mapper.select: SELECT plan_yr::int AS year,substring(plan_ym,6,2)::int AS month,bsn_part_id AS part_id, trgt_sls_amt AS revenue,trgt_bsn_prft_amt AS profit,trgt_utlz_rt AS utilization FROM fin.biz_plan WHERE plan_yr=lpad(CAST(#{year} AS text),4,'0') ORDER BY plan_ym,bsn_part_id NULLS FIRST
SELECT bsn_part_id AS id,bsn_part_nm AS name,use_yn='Y' AS active FROM mst.bsn_part ORDER BY sort_seq,bsn_part_id
SELECT cls_ym FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE substring(cls_ym,1,4)=lpad(CAST(#{year} AS text),4,'0') AND cls_stts_cd='CLOSED' ORDER BY cls_ym
SELECT cls_ym FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE substring(cls_ym,1,4)=lpad(CAST(#{year} AS text),4,'0') ORDER BY cls_ym FOR SHARE

INSERT INTO fin.biz_plan(plan_yr,plan_ym,bsn_part_id,trgt_sls_amt,trgt_bsn_prft_amt,trgt_utlz_rt,created_by) VALUES(lpad(CAST(#{input.year} AS text),4,'0'),#{planMonth},#{input.partId},#{input.target_revenue}, #{input.target_operating_profit},#{input.target_utilization_rate},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT uk_biz_plan_plan_ym_bsn_part_id DO UPDATE SET trgt_sls_amt=EXCLUDED.trgt_sls_amt,trgt_bsn_prft_amt=EXCLUDED.trgt_bsn_prft_amt, trgt_utlz_rt=EXCLUDED.trgt_utlz_rt,updated_by=#{actor},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP RETURNING biz_plan_id

SELECT p.prj_id AS project_id,m.month,h.bsn_part_id AS part_id FROM prj.prj p CROSS JOIN ( SELECT lpad(CAST(#{year} AS text),4,'0')||'-'||lpad(n::text,2,'0') AS month FROM generate_series(1,12) n ) m LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT bsn_part_id FROM prj.prj_part_hist h WHERE h.prj_id=p.prj_id AND h.aply_bgn_ym <= m.month ORDER BY h.aply_bgn_ym DESC,h.part_hist_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) h ON true ORDER BY p.prj_id,m.month
SELECT substring(pl_ym,6,2)::int AS month,sls_amt AS revenue,bsn_prft_amt AS profit FROM fin.mth_pl WHERE pl_ym=#{month} AND pl_src_cd='CLOSE'
